test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In 2023, the philanthropic organisation Carnegie Corporation of New York placed Ajay Banga, the President of ______, on its annual 'Great Immigrants' list. This list consists of honourees who have enriched and strengthened America and its democracy through their contributions and actions.
solution:
The correct answer is __**World Bank**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Ajay Banga is the current President of the **World Bank**, having assumed office on June 2, 2023.
 
• He was included in the Carnegie Corporation of New York's **'Great Immigrants' list for 2023**, which honors individuals who have made significant contributions to America and its democracy.
 
• The Carnegie Corporation annually recognizes immigrants who enrich American society through their professional achievements, philanthropy, and civic engagement.
 
• Ajay Banga, an Indian-American, is celebrated for his expertise in global economic leadership and commitment to addressing issues such as poverty and inequality through his role at the World Bank.
 
• Before joining the World Bank, Ajay Banga served as CEO of Mastercard and played a critical role in advancing digital payment systems globally.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **World Bank:**

 
 
• The World Bank is an international financial institution that provides loans and grants to governments for developmental projects aimed at reducing poverty and boosting economic growth.
 
• It consists of two institutions: the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD) and the International Development Association (IDA).
 
• Founded in 1944, the World Bank is headquartered in Washington, D.C., USA.
 
 
 
• **Carnegie Corporation of New York:**
 
 
• Founded by Andrew Carnegie in 1911, this philanthropic organization focuses on education, international peace, and the advancement of knowledge.
 
• Its 'Great Immigrants' initiative highlights the contributions of immigrants to American society.
 
 
 
• **Immigrant Contributions in the United States:**
 
 
• Immigrants in the U.S. have historically contributed to innovation, economic growth, and cultural diversity.
 
• Many leading figures in science, technology, business, and arts in the U.S. are immigrants.
 
 
 
• **Ajay Banga’s Leadership:**
 
 
• Ajay Banga is known for his emphasis on financial inclusion and sustainability.
 
• He has been instrumental in driving initiatives aimed at improving access to financial services for underserved populations globally.
